exposure: Intrauterine position (developing between female fetuses only (0M) vs. one or two males (1/2M))
outcome: Inflammatory profiles (fetal brain levels of pro- and anti-inflammatory cytokines, TNF-a)
cohort: The study included C57BL/6N mice, with MIA induced by maternal administration of poly(I:C) on gestation day 12.
finding: MIA-exposed offspring developing between female fetuses (0M-MIA) displayed significant deficits in sociability and sensorimotor gating at adult age, and sustained elevated fetal brain TNF-a levels, unlike those developing between one or two males (1/2M-MIA).
followup_time: Adult age (for behavioral outcomes); late gestation (for some brain measures)
